Problem Statement:
Given an array of N elements, find the elements A[i], A[j] and A[k] in the array such that A[i]+A[j]=A[k] and i < j < k . Print number of possibilities. 
Input Description:
Input Size : 1 <= N <= 1000 
Sample Input:
5
1 2 3 4 5 
Sample Output:
4
